jobs.description: Automated AI Network Monitoring Solution | NetOp Cloud Platform AI Network Monitoring Solution Network Assessment & Modernization Reports Predictive Network Analytics Solution Automated Network Management Solution Smart AIOps Solution Markets Enterprises MSPs About Team Careers News Contact Us Resources White Papers Case Studies Blogs Become a Partner Get a Demo AI Network Monitoring Like You’ve Never Seen! Boost your operation with our AI-based automated network monitoring system that provides early detection, real-time insights & auto troubleshooting! Smarter, more efficient network management and operations solution that deploys in minutes. NetOp’s AI-network monitoring solution is a game-changer in the realm of proactive network health and monitoring. It automatically learns your network’s normal behavior, detects issues before they manifest, and provides real-time insights that pinpoint the reasons for potential failures or poor user experiences. NetOp’s innovative AI-driven solution, learns your network’s behavior, quickly identifying potential issues and reducing detection time for significant problems. It provides precise real-time insights for potential failures or poor user experiences, drastically cutting resolution time. Additionally, NetOp’s automated analysis reduces the need for manual expert intervention, significantly saving time and operational costs. Transform your network management with the efficiency and effectiveness of NetOp’s AI monitoring platform! Get a Demo AI Network Monitoring Features Early Detection NetOp detects and uniquely identifies significant anomalies by analyzing patterns of irregular behavior, metrics, alerts, or events. It anticipates risk-based issues, alerting to potential critical impacts well before they disrupt users. Utilizing machine learning and AI, NetOp recognizes which anomalies require immediate attention. Moreover, NetOp.cloud offers actionable insights for effective remediation. To ensure prompt attention, NetOp.cloud delivers targeted notifications across various channels, highlighting urgent issues for quick resolution. Read More Real-Time, AI Network Insights Improve your organization’s networking capabilities with our 24/7 real-time AI network monitoring. NetOp’s AI-driven tools automatically and continuously analyze network data, offering unrivaled insights into your network’s health. Cloud-apps and SaaS Network Insights Pinpoint the reasons for degraded user quality of experience with SaaS and Cloud-based apps. NetOp pinpoints the answer to questions like “Why is my video meeting application so slow? And what’s needed to resolve it? Are issues originating from the cloud-based apps, internal network issues, or internet service providers? Read More Automated Troubleshooting and Analytics Simplify network issue resolution with AI-powered automation. Our monitoring solutions truly diagnose network problems, recommend specific fixes, and minimize time to resolution resulting in minimal network degradation and downtime. Read More Scalable Solutions Whether you need a monitoring solution for a small business, mid-size business, or a global enterprise infrastructure, our AI Network Monitoring tools scale to meet your demands. You can begin small and expand as your network grows. Intelligent Network incidents and Notifications Receive smart network notifications with input from multiple sources and multi-layers, so that one impactful issue across your entire network doesn’t create 1000 alerts (efficiency is our motto). Through continuous learning of performance baselines, our system significantly reduces alert noise by 90%, providing clear explanations for incidents. It intelligently correlates and aggregates related alerts, streamlining notifications. You’ll receive prompt updates via email, SMS, or mobile app, keeping you well-informed of critical network events. Read More Proactive Management for Autonomous Network Health Today’s networks are heterogeneous. They contain numerous devices – Wi-Fi, firewalls SD-Wan, SASE – that may support multiple services (or fabrics) running over the same equipment. Each of these elements has scores of configuration requirements, which occasionally need to be changed, say if the traffic shaping needs change, or a new fabric is added for video conferencing. Changes occur all the time that are not necessarily business-driven, for example, an application is updated on the cloud and needs access to a new firewall port. And each and every change may lead to a network slowdown or outage. User-Friendly Unified Dashboard NetOp collects network metrics and information from all cloud-managed network devices, and unifies them into a single dashboard so you gain immediate visibility. Taking it a step further, NetOp.cloud’s proprietary machine learning and AI correlates and distills insights about the fabrics and networks. Health scores and easy-to-understand indicators let anyone – even without IT expertise – understand what is happening. You can drill into the dashboard to see at the level you need: tenant venue, network, all the way down to each individual piece of equipment. Taking Action & Closing the Loop NetOp’s mission is to use its AI and ML capabilities to perform corrective actions automatically and issue a recommendation for user action, depending on company policy. The actions may include configuration changes or reboots. NetOp implements the actions and maintains a clear history of fixes to be referred to by managers or by the software itself. After fixing each issue, NetOp closes the loop by continuously monitoring and fixing again if necessary. With NetOp’s AI monitoring tools, you can troubleshoot quickly, regardless of where the problem lies, and turn your NOC into a proactive business asset. (“ NetOp ”, “ we ”) is committed to maintaining the privacy of its users (“ user ”, “ you ”). The following information describes how NetOp collects and processes information about you when you use our Services (as defined below). Our Privacy Policy explains: What information we collect and why we collect it. How we use that information. Your rights with regard to the collection of such information. By using our Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy. NetOp provides its users with an artificial intelligence powered network optimization platform (the “ Platform ”) which allows its users to increase productivity, maintain network health, optimize network operations, automate network related workflow and facilitate cross-domain network operations via the identification and validation of network elements. The Platform includes a dashboard which reflects to its users, network analysis conducted by NetOp and recommended actions to be taken to optimize network management processes. NetOp is also engaged in the ideation, development, maintenance and provision of a website (the “ Website ”) which provides information on NetOp’s Platform (the Platform and Website shall be defined collectively herein as the “ Services ”). Collecting Information Please note that the scope of this Privacy Policy is limited only to information collected by NetOp through your use of its Services. Some information may be automatically collected, and some is collected when you interact with our Website or Platform. The type of information that may be automatically collected is non-personal information, which includes your session durations, the content you accessed on the Services, the frequency and scope of your use of the Services and information about your computer and internet connection including the operating system you use and browser type. Information from which you can be personally identified may also be collected, including but not limited to your name, email address, telephone number, company, any notes, content you may upload to our blog, your curriculum vitae, the content of your communication with us and the location of the computer through which you used the Services (hereinafter: “ Personal Information ”). Personal Information shall be collected only if received voluntarily from you, including, without limitation, by registering to our Services or completing the contact forms available through the Services. Use of Information We use the Personal Information we collect from you for a range of different business purposes according to different legal bases of processing. We may use or process your Personal Information for the following purposes. One or more purposes may apply simultaneously. Providing the Requested Services We collect Personal Information to provide you with our network optimization Platform. We collect Personal Information to provide our users with our blog and to allow our users to easily apply for a job at NetOp. Such collection of information will enable us to provide you with technical and professional assistance, with regard to the Services you use or intend to use. We process the Personal Information where it is necessary for the adequate performance of the contract regarding the requested Services. Improvement and Development of the Services We collect Personal Information to improve and develop our Services and understand feedback on NetOp’s Services and to help provide more information on the use of those Services quickly and easily. We collect Personal Information for ongoing review and improvement of the information provided on our Website and Platform to ensure they are user friendly. We collect Personal Information to improve the management and administration of our business and maintain compliancy with our internal policies and procedures. We conduct surveys and research, test features in development, and analyze the information we have to evaluate and improve our Services, develop new features, and conduct audits and troubleshooting activities. We process this information in light of our legitimate interest in improving the Services, to allow our users to have the best experience. Maintain a Safe and Secure Environment We may use your information to detect and prevent fraud, abuse and security incidents in the following ways; Verify and authenticate your identity and prevent unauthorized or illegal activity; Enhance the safety and security of our Services; Conduct security investigations and risk assessments; Prevent or take action against activities that are, or may be, in breach of our terms of service or applicable law. We process this information in light of our legitimate interest in improving our Services and enabling our users to browse in a secure environment. Personalize Content, Advertising and Marketing If you have used NetOp’s Services in the past, we have a legitimate business interest for matching the data we collect with other data we had already collected. This enables us to understand your needs and interests, optimize the content we send you and make it more suitable and relevant to your needs. This also enables us to improve your experience on our Services by providing you with personalized content, recommendations, and features. We process this information in light of our legitimate interest to personalize your experience and customize our content.
